column2: $$ゴッド$$ is angry... It seems a great flood has struck the lower world!
There is no way the creatures without $$羽$$ will survive that...
At least I hope the children they had with us lower-ranking angels survive...
The creatures without $$羽$$ must be...
our ancestors, the $$サル達$$...
$$メフィスト$$, the black-$$羽$$ed $$大天使$$,
seems to have given the $$知恵の実$$ to those $$羽$$less $$サル達$$...
No matter how similar they look,
I do not think we should give such violent $$サル達$$ wisdom so freely...
I have an awful feeling they will eventually destroy this entire $$世界$$...
That is what I fear!
Those white angels say
we must not give wisdom to the $$サル$$, but...
their idea is that only we angels should monopolize wisdom forever,
a wretched, rotten way of thinking!!
Not a cold-$$血$$ed, heartless $$ゴッド$$ like the current one, who casually wipes out living beings,
but someone compassionate like Lord $$メフィスト$$ is the one worthy of being called a god...
Ever since the $$サル達$$ ate the forbidden $$知恵の実$$,
they learned to use fire and advanced their civilization in the blink of an eye...
But the white-$$羽$$ed king of the $$大天使$$s at that time, $$ゴッド$$, was angered by this...
He brought a great flood upon the land and wiped out the poor $$サル達$$!!
That $$メフィスト$$...
He must have intended from the beginning to use this civil war to drag $$ゴッド$$ down from his divine station...
and seize the position of the next Lord $$ハ・サタン$$ for himself!!
Hey...
They say I cannot wear an angel's armor, despite being an angel, because I have no conviction...
I am sure I died in the last battle, so why am I here...?
Welcome!
All the weapons infused with angelic power were taken away in this war!
Then why am I still running a shop, you ask?
...... The truth is, there are still some left!
Who knows...? I do not know either!
Welcome...?
Do you think saying that will let you enter the shop?
Ha ha ha ha ha... H-huh...?
Eek! W-what is that!?
The fighting has finally begun!!
Why must white angels and black angels fight just because those creatures without $$羽$$
have gone extinct!?
Those barbaric creatures...
They should all just die!!
Could these people possibly have died...
during the $$創世記戦争$$!?
Yes
No
Have you come again!?
No matter how often you return, I will not become your $$奴隷$$!!
Could you be the $$ご主人様$$ that person was looking for!?
Oh, you do not seem to be with the $$アンゲルス教$$.
Will you save me?
Thank you very much. My name is $$フィム$$!
It seems you are not the person after all!
Take her with us!!
Do not take her with us!
Yes!! I must repay you for saving me!
Yes!! I can manage to escape alone from here!
